title: ‘Kerala @70’: Manorama News Conclave 2026 begins in Kochi, focuses on state’s future
content: Kochi: The Manorama News Conclave 2026, a forum bringing together leading voices to discuss issues shaping the nation's future, began on Saturday at Lulu Bolgatty International Convention Centre in Kochi. This year's conclave, themed 'Kerala @70', features a diverse line-up of speakers, including Union Civil Aviation Minister Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan, CPM General Secretary M A Baby and Chief of the Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan. Launched in 2017, the Manorama News Conclave has explored themes ranging from happiness and freedom to the idea of a new India. The day-long forum brings together political leaders, experts, artists and other prominent voices for conversations and debates on issues of contemporary relevance. Here's a quick look at the sessions lined up for this year's conclave: 9 am | Inauguration Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu (Union Minister for Civil Aviation) 10 am | Turbulence and takeoff: Indian aviation — From disruption to transformation Kinjarapu Rammohan Naidu, Hibi Eden (MP) 10.15 am | Generation unscripted: Dreams, disruptions and the new language of success Gouri Kishan (Actor), Raul John Aju (AI entrepreneur), Fathima Tahiliya (MLA) | Mariya Jomon 11 am | The real Left: Who speaks for progressive politics in India today? M A Baby (General Secretary, CPM) | A Ayyappadas 11.45 am | Kerala on the edge: Lessons, preparedness and the climate challenge Dr S Abhilash (Atmospheric Scientist), C K Vishnudas (Ecologist - Ornithologist) | Binu Aravindan 12.30 pm | Growth with purpose: ESG and the new rules of responsible business M P Ahammed (Chairman, Malabar Group) | Prasanth R Nair 2 pm | The art of speaking truth Dr Edanad Rajan Nambiar (Chakyarkoothu exponent) 2.45 pm | Growth and ground realities: Building the next Keralam P K Kunhalikutty (Minister for Industries and Commerce, Kerala), Jose Thomas (CMD, Choice Group), Minu Chithambaram (CEO, KCA), Tom M Joseph (Director, New Initiatives, Jain University) | Shani Prabhakaran 3.45 pm | Oceans of influence: Why the oceans Will Shape India's Future Admiral Krishna Swaminathan (Chief of the Naval Staff) | Nisha Purushothaman 4.45 pm | What Happened to Keralam? How Kerala's society, values and aspirations have changed Ramesh Pisharody (MLA), Vinoy Thomas (Author), Adeela Abdulla IAS (Secretary, PWD) | Jayamohan 5.30 pm | The Urvashi effect: How an actor transcended generations, genres and expectations Urvashi (Actor) 6 pm | Valedictory Address: The next Kerala — Rethinking Kerala's future in a changing India V D Satheesan (Chief Minister, Kerala) | Johny Lukose
